incidents.body:
The issue affecting the availability of some Webflow MCP Server tools in the Claude Desktop app and claude.ai has now been resolved. All Webflow MCP tools should now be available in the Claude connector.
If you previously experienced missing tools, restarting Claude Desktop or refreshing claude.ai may help ensure the latest tool list is displayed.
We’re no longer seeing customer impact related to this issue. Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve it.
incidents.title: [RESOLVED] Reports of some missing tooling from the Webflow MCP Server

incidents.body:
The Webflow MCP Server is operating as expected, and this incident is now resolved.

If any tools are still missing in the Claude apps, refresh the tool list by following these steps:

  1. Go to Settings.
  2. Select Connectors.
  3. Click the Webflow connector.
  4. Click the three-dot menu.
  5. Select Refresh tool list.

Thank you for your patience while we worked through this issue.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience that this issue caused, and appreciate your patience and understanding while we worked to resolve it.

incidents.body:
Access to the Dashboard and Webflow.com has been fully restored, and this incident is now resolved. The disruption occurred between approximately 16:04 UTC and 17:32 UTC. If you continue to encounter issues, please clear your browser cache (Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + R) and try again.

The issue was caused by a third-party tracker on webflow.com. We have implemented a change to prevent this from happening again. Customers who were already logged into the Webflow Designer or Dashboard may not have been affected, and no Webflow hosted sites were impacted.

We sincerely appreciate your patience while our team worked to restore full access.

incidents.body: Our third-party provider has implemented a fix, and impacted services should now be working as expected. If your site was published during the incident, we recommend republishing it at this time to ensure everything updates correctly.

incidents.title: Issues saving changes in the Designer

incidents.body:
The issue impacting the delivery of website assets via our CDN (cdn.prod.website-files.com) for users in Singapore has been resolved. We’ve verified the fix implemented by the third-party provider, and asset requests are now functioning as expected.

If visitors are still unable to access Webflow-hosted sites, we recommend the following:
- Restart your device.
- Clear your browser and DNS caches.
- If the issue persists, contact your local ISP and ask them to check their DNS configuration for cdn.prod.website-files.com.

We appreciate your patience throughout this incident.
incidents.title: CDN assets not loading as expected in the Designer and hosted sites for customers in Singapore
